source_index.note: Immutable metadata index; no shard was materialized.

embedding_and_tied_output.status: derived_from_vocab_times_hidden; remains BF16 because tied embedding/output is excluded from vLLM online FP8 linear quantization

language_mlp_linear.status: derived: 60 * 3 * hidden * intermediate; quantized by the nominated W8A8 FP8 path

language_attention_linear.status: derived from 50 sliding and 10 global Q/K/V/O shapes; quantized by the nominated path

vision_and_small_non_linear_remainder.status: derived residual from authoritative total after explicit text classes; includes vision projection/blocks and norms/scalars. Treating all residual bytes as FP8 is optimistic for fit, while the bound below retains a BF16 scratch allowance

steady_state_bound.interpretation: Fits at gpu_memory_utilization=0.92 under the stated conservative allowance; this is a bound, not a CUDA measurement. Enforce eager and max_model_len=10000 for the first arm.

load_time.required_behavior: CPU-side shard streaming or layerwise on-load quantization; do not stage a full BF16 copy on the L40S
load_time.closure_condition: If the pinned image attempts full-GPU BF16 materialization and OOMs before the first request, record typed load_memory_oom and close this route; do not create a successor.

kv_method: 2 bytes per BF16 scalar; K and V counted; sliding layers capped at 1024; full layers retain context
uncertainty: Online FP8 scale storage and temporary workspaces are runtime-dependent.
The exact CUDA load path and Gemma4 FP8 numerical behavior require the nominated L40S consumer run.
No throughput or quality is transferred from H100 or third-party FP8 services.
